MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) 
 
 This Memorandum of Understanding (“ MOU ”) is entered into at Lahore on this 24 th day of February 2020 (“ Effective Date ”), by and between Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“ Zameen ”) and Mr. Muhammad Amir son of Samsaamuddin , resident of House No. 15-E, Block B, Gulistan Zafar PRECHS, near SMCHS, Karachi, bearing CNIC 42201-5928166-1 (“ Partner ”) . 
 
 Zameen and Partner shall be referred to individually as “ Party ” and collectively as “ Parties ”. 
 
 WHEREAS : 
 
 Partner is the sole and absolute legal owner of the property measuring 11 acres (90.02 Kanals ) located at Plot No. 158/1, NA Class No. 158, Deh Tore, Tappo Konkar , Taluka Murad Memon , Distt. Malir , Karachi (“ Property ”) ; 
 
 The Parties intend to enter into a joint venture with respect to a real estate Project (defined below) and are executing this MOU to document such intention and to provide a general framework for further negotiations between the Parties ; and 
 
 The Parties have agreed, subject to the terms of this MOU, to discuss and finalize the terms and conditions for entering into formal agreements in relation to the Project (defined below) . 
 
 NOW THEREFORE , the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 DEFINITIONS 
 
 Cash Disbursal Model means a mutually agreed disbursal model of cash flow s of the JV , which shall be determined as a function of sales; 
 Initial Construction means installation of the main gate, building of the site office, model villa/apartment and parks at the Property; 
 Instalment means each monthly instalment of the Payment Plan; 
 Payment Plan means the two (2) years monthly instalment plan of the Sale Consideration (defined below) ; 
 Sale Consideration means total consideration, that is an amount of Rs. 348,750,000 (Rupees three hundred forty-eight million seven hundred fifty thousand) , to be paid by the Joint Venture to the Partner for the sale, transfer and conveyance of the Property in the name of the JV ; 
 Marketing Company means Zameen Media ( Private ) Limited, an entity in dependent of the Parties hereto, whose services shall be employed for exclusive marketing and sales of the Project ; 
 Transfer &amp; Approvals Cost means the directly associated cost s that are incurred by the JV with respect to the transfer of the Property in the name of the Joint Venture ; the preparation, submission and grant of approvals from the concerned development authorities ; and the Initial Construction ; 
 Project means the prospective residential &amp; commercial real estate project to be undertaken , planned, constructed and devel oped by the JV on the Property, under the name and style of Zameen Ahlaam Green City (“ZAGC” ) ; 
 Project Expenses mean the general expenses of the JV , including inter alia selling, marketing, development, management and operational costs of the JV . 
 Property means the property located at Plot No. 158/1, NA Class No. 158, Deh Tore, Tappo Konkar , Taluka Mu rad Memon , Distt. Malir , Karachi ; 
 J oint V enture or JV means the association of persons, body corporate or any other legal entity or contractual arrangement formulated between the Parties through mutual agreement to manage the Project undertaken by the Parties for the planning, construction, development and selling of the Project . 
 
 FORMATION OF A J OINT V ENTURE 
 
 The Parties hereby agree to enter into an agreement to establish the JV to undertake the Project on the Property , wherein each Party shall hold equal ownership in the Joint Venture (JV) on a 50/50 profit and loss sharing basis . Zameen’s initial capital investment in the JV shall be the Transfer &amp; Approvals Cost, whereas the Partner’s initial capital investment shall be the sale and transfer of the Property to the JV, whereas further investments may be required based on Project or JV needs. 
 
 The Parties hereby agree and acknowledge that Zameen may enter into the JV agreement, either on its own or through its associated company. 
 
 PROPERTY TRANSFER 
 
 Partner hereby agrees to enter into an agreement to sell with the JV whereby the Partner shall sell , transfer and convey the Property in the name of the J oint V enture , in consideration whereof the JV shall pay to the Partner the Sale Consideration in accordance with the Payment Plan . 
 
 Sale Consideration to the Partner shall be paid in accordance with the Payment Plan and clause 5 (c) of this MOU , which shall commence one ( 1 ) month after launch of Project sales. Each Instalment shall be calculated at twenty percent (20%) of all monthly revenues generated from Project sales , within a period of two (2) years from the commencement of the Payment Plan . For the avoidance of doubt, revenues shall include the cashflows generated through new sales each month as well as instalments received each month with respect to sales in previous months. 
 
 In the event that the total Sale Consideration is not paid from the aforementioned revenues within a period of two (2) years , Zameen shall pay to the Partner the remaining Sale Consideration within four (4) months thereof . 
 
 PROJECT STRUCTURE AND MANAGEMENT 
 
 The Parties shall manage various operations of the JV on mutual agreement, including inter alia construction, design, and development of the Project , facility management of the Project after completion, accounting and financial management of the JV . 
 
 A n independent quantity/quality surveyor and financial auditor shall be hired to independent ly review the progress and expenses of the Project’s construction , as well as the operations of the JV . 
 
 Project shall be structure d to have towers, villas, residential apartments, commercial units , car parking , and the maximum permitted height , subject to applicable zoning laws, rules , and regulations. Th e design and concept of the Pro j e ct shall be mutually agreed between the Parties, along with timelines for development and construction thereof, which shall form an integral part of the business arrangement between the Parties. The remaining civil, structural and architectural development for the Project shall be outsourced to an architectural firm mutually agreed between the Parties. 
 
 Partner represents that the Partner has already prepared certain blueprints , architectural plans , drawings and structural designs which the Partner shall provide to Zameen prior to the formation of the Joint Venture , on the basis whereof the submissions for requisite approvals shall be prepared and submitted by Zameen on behalf of the JV . 
 
 Project sales and marketing shall be exclusively handled by the Marketing Company for a service or marketing fee of ten percent (10%) of the sale price of each unit sold in the Project , with its ultimate objective being the success of the Project . The Marketing Company shall share sales targets and marketing plans for the Project with the JV for its approval . Furthermore, the Marketing Company shall be responsible for recovery of a maximum of thirty percent (30%) of the unit price. For the avoidance of doubt, the recovery of remaining seventy percent (70%) of the unit price shall be the responsibility of the JV for which the JV shall hire a team of professionals comprising of 2 to 3 full-time members. Zameen shall provide requisite training to this team. All expenses associated with recruiting, training, and compensating this team shall be the responsibility of the JV . 
 
 Marketing Company shall formally market and initiate the selling of the Project once all necessary approvals, clearances, and NOCs from concerned authorities have been obtained . 
 
 Upon completion of the Project, the Project shall be managed through a mutually agreed facilities management plan . 
 OPERATIONS AND FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT 
 
 Each Party shall have complete visibility of the finance s, accounts and management of the JV and Project. 
 
 The Joint Venture shall establish a primary joint bank account at such banking facility as mutually agreed between the Parties for management of cash flows . 
 
 Cash Disbursal Model and payment of Project Expenses shall be a function of monthly cash flows generated from Project sales. Monthly c ash flows shall be utilized in the following manner: 
 
 Twenty-percent ( 20% ) shall be paid to the Partner in lieu of Instalments for Sale Consideration, p ursuant to clause 3 above, until such time as the remaining I nstalment s for th e remaining Sale Consideration are equal to Zameen’s initial capital investments in the JV; 
 
 Once the , remaining Instalments for Sale Consideration are equal to Zameen’s initial capital investment, then twenty percent (20%) each of the monthly cash flows or any other amount in equal proportion as agreed between both parties shall be paid to both Zameen and the Partner , until such time as the Instalments and Zameen’s initial investment are fully paid; 
 
 In both i ) and ii) above, all remaining cash flows shall be utilised towards construction , marketing expenses and operational costs of the JV . 
 
 Zameen shall share with Partner, prior to entering into any formal definitive agreements envisaged in this MOU, projected cash flows expected to be generated through Project sales. 
 
 Neither Party shall draw from the revenues generated from the Project, unless mutually agreed between the Parties in writing . Provided that, the drawing of each Party shall always be equal and made o n the basis of their profit sharing ratio. For the avoidance of doubt, in the event that a Party makes any drawings from the Project, subject to mutual agreement hereunder, the other Party shall always be entitled to equal drawing at the same time or at a differed date . 
 
 Subject to Clause 5 ( e ) above , profits shall not be drawn by either Party until both Parties have recovered their capital investments . Each Party’s drawings from the profits shall be as per the agreed profit and loss sharing ratio of 50/50. 
 
 GENERAL 
 
 Partner warrants that the Partner is the sole and absolute owner of the Property and the Property is free from any disputes, claims, liens, mortgages, charges, burdens and encu mbrances of any kind whatsoever, and the P artner shall furnish customary warranties and indemnities with respect thereto, including indemnify ing Zameen and the JV against all such claims, damages, losses, costs, expenses, encumbrances, charges etc. and Partner shall be exclusively liable to litigate and resolve any such dispute or remove any such encumbrance. 
 
 The Parties agree that the anticipated Project must be financially beneficial to both Parties, and, as such, agree to enter into good faith negotiations to transcribe the terms for formation of the JV . 
 
 The proposed Project shall be structured and implemented in accordance with all applicable laws of Pakistan . 
 
 Either Party shall have the right to terminate th eir participation in this MOU unilaterally without cause or notice . Without prejudice to the foregoing, steps shall be taken to ensure that termination of participation in this MOU shall not be prejudicial to any agreed activities or joint projects undertaken within the framework of the MOU or to the completion of tasks for which obligations may exist. 
 
 The Parties agree and understand that this MOU is non-binding and shall be subject to formal definitive agreements that the Parties may execute within a reasonable period of time from the date hereof . Accordingly , the Parties together may undertake detailed negotiations on financial , technical, and legal terms and conditions with a view to enter into formal agreement(s). It is further acknowledged that it is not practically possible to incorporate each and every eventuality in this MOU. Thus, it is understood and declared that any such eventuality that might be unforeseen in this MOU shall be provided for in the agreement(s) with the mutual consent of the P arties thereto. 
 
 This MOU may be amended upon written mutual consent of all Parties hereto, and any such amendment shall be an integral part of this MOU. 
 
 The Parties agree to resolve any dispute between the Parties through direct negotiations in good faith. However, if not resolved within 15 (fifteen ) days of the dispute so arising, it shall be referred for arbitration to be conducted under the Arbitration Act (X of 1940). The venue of arbitration shall be Karachi and the language used shall be English. The d ecision and award of arbitration shall be final and binding on both Parties, including decision as to costs. 
 
 The Parties acknowledge that this MOU shall be treated as a highly confidential document and its content and any information shared by either Party in connection therewith shall not be disclosed, copied, shared, publicized or circulated in any manner whatsoever, except by mutual written consent of the disclosing Party . 
 
 Th e J oint V enture will be formed exclusively and for the limited purposes of the planning, development, construction and selling of the P roject defined herein. The P arties stand indemnified completely by each other aga inst any liability except this P roject . 
 
 Neither P arty will assign or transfer any rights or obligations under this MOU without the prior written consent of the other party.  Any such assignment without prior consent shall be null and void.   
 
 This MOU may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument. 
 
 Nothing contained herein shall be construed or deemed to create any association, partnership or joint venture, agency, or employer-employee relationship in any manner whatsoever between the Parties. 
 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this MOU as of the date first written above :
